text: So you add a support button.
There it sits. Every page, every day.
QuietJar gives it a finish line: this month's hosting.
People chip in, and the bar fills.
Two taps, right on your page. Apple Pay, iDEAL, or card.
Next month, it's back for the next bill.
No monthly fee. Just five percent of what you receive.
Ask when it matters. Then go quiet.
